question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"burned."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"burned"** means to be destroyed or damaged by fire. (आग या ताप से जलाना, हानि पहुँचाना या जख्‍़मी करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *We took all the rubbish outside and **burned**__ it.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
